title: Music
myListsEmptyTitle: No lists of your own yet
myListsEmptyDescription: Collected songs and lists you create appear here; songlists and charts need a music source first.
libraryEmptyTitle: The song library is on its way
libraryEmptyDescription: Once a music source lands, songs will page in here as a masonry grid of cards.
playlistsEmptyDescription: Playlists you curate and follow will live here.
chartsEmptyDescription: Popular-song charts from the music sources will live here.
defaultSourceDesc: The source a song is asked from; lx-music resolves play URLs through the imported custom-source scripts.
defaultSourceEmpty: No source yet — import a script under Custom sources below.
qualityDesc: The rendition asked of a source; a source that lacks it answers with the best it has.
skipOnErrorDesc: Moves to the next source when one cannot answer, instead of stopping.
autoplayDesc: Continues the last queue when the music module opens.
addToTopDesc: Off keeps them at the end of a list.
showSourceDesc: Marks which source a song came from beside its row.
playbackResetDesc: Automatic source, 320K, skip failures, new songs at the end.
sourcesHint: lx-music custom sources are JavaScript scripts run by the fjs (QuickJS) runtime; importing initializes them and hands play-URL resolution to them.
sourcesImportTextDesc: Paste the full text of an lx-music custom-source script.
sourcesImportUrlDesc: Downloads the .js at an address and imports it.
importMissing: Paste a script or fill in a link first.
importNotASource: This is not an lx-music source: the header comment has no @name, or the lx.on('request', …) contract is missing.
importLimit: At most {count} custom sources; remove one first.
sourcesEmptyDesc: Import an lx-music custom-source script and it appears here.
sourceDeleteDesc: Its script is deleted too; importing it again restores it.
sourcesReloadDesc: Initialize every imported lx script again.
searchIdleDescription: Type a title, an artist or an album and press enter.
mineEmptyDescription: Songs you collect or play appear here.
lyricsEmpty: This song has no lyrics yet.
playlistDeleteDesc: The playlist is removed; its songs are not deleted.
playlistEmptyDescription: Add songs from a row’s “More actions” menu.
downloadDuplicate: This song is already in the download queue
downloadUnsupported: This song has no downloadable source (a local file, or not covered by the current source)
downloadHint: Files land in the shared download folder; the queue supports pause, resume and retry.
downloadDirectoryDefaultDesc: Return to the app’s default downloads folder.
downloadTypeDesc: Original keeps the source container; transcoding needs ffmpeg.
downloadPatternHint: Placeholders (written inside braces): title, artist, album, quality, source, list, index.
downloadEmbedCoverDesc: Write the cover into the audio tags.
downloadEmbedLyricDesc: Write the lyric into the audio tags so it travels with the file.
downloadWriteLyricDesc: Write a sibling .lrc next to the audio file.
downloadSkipExistingDesc: Do not download when the output file is already there.
downloadGroupByListDesc: When downloading from a playlist, save into a folder named after it.
downloadsEmptyDescription: Download from a row’s “More actions” menu; files go to {directory}.
localHint: Add a folder of audio files; the scan makes them play like online songs.
localEmptyDescription: Add a folder of audio files to start scanning.
lyricOffsetDesc: Positive values show the lyric later.
lyricTranslationDesc: Show the translation when the lyric has one.
lyricRomanizationDesc: Show the romanization when the lyric has one.
lyricHint: The display and delay apply to every song; desktop lyrics open from Settings or the player’s More actions menu.
desktopLyricsUnavailable: This platform has no desktop lyric window, or the permission was refused
desktopLyricHint: Desktop lyrics are a floating window you can drag, lock and control; Android needs the overlay permission.
desktopLyricEnableDesc: Float the current lyric over the desktop; turning it off keeps the style below.
desktopLyricLockDesc: A locked window lets clicks pass through to the app underneath.
desktopLyricOpacityDesc: The opacity of the whole overlay window.
desktopLyricAlignmentDesc: How the line is anchored in the window.
